summary: 75-foot Moose Hill tower near Sharon, MA, built 1966 per the Register; predecessor dates conflict (1916/1917); the 1912 Bluff Hill site is a separate former-site record.

facts.agency: Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control

events.note: Former 30-foot steel tower on Bluff Hill (Bluff Head per the Register), on private land with permission; former-site record
Former Bluff Hill tower staffed until 1916, then removed at end of fire season. The Weebly page dates a new 40-foot Moose Hill tower to 1916
Register: earlier Moose Hill tower erected 1917, replacing the 1912 Bluff Head tower. Conflicts with the 1916 date on the Weebly page
75-foot steel tower with 10x10 cab on Moose Hill, replacing the earlier tower
Former-site record (Bluff Hill, US 23, MA 23) registered September 3, 2008
State maintenance crew replaced the inside floor and an inside wall of the cab

corrections.why: The Register gives the standing tower as 75 feet (about 22.9 m). The brief's 12.2 m (40 ft) matches the older 40-foot predecessor, not the tower standing today.

corrections.current: Sharon Tower Site #1 treated as part of the standing tower's record
corrections.proposed: Keep the FFLOS entry as a separate former-site record for the 1912 Bluff Hill tower, removed 1916
corrections.why: The former-site page describes a 30-foot tower built in 1912 and removed in 1916. It does not describe the 1966 tower on Moose Hill.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says the earlier Moose Hill tower was erected in 1917. The Weebly page says a new 40-foot tower was erected at Moose Hill in 1916. Both are reported in the story; not resolved.
The Register calls the older site Bluff Head; the former-site record calls it Bluff Hill. The story uses Bluff Hill only where it quotes that record.

sources.title: Southern New England Chapter report for 2015

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 12.2 is the older 40-foot predecessor; the standing tower is 75 ft. The FFLOS entry Sharon Tower Site #1 is a separate 1912 former site removed in 1916 and should not be merged into this record. Brief FFLOS coordinates were not verified on the FFLOS page; NHLR coordinates are on the Register page but not used. A Facebook search snippet mentions a 1992 cab rebuild; the post was not readable through fetch, so it is not used. Staffing and visitor access are not stated in any page read; the story says so. Moose Hill sanctuary boundary vs tower location is unconfirmed.
